cases.name: Patricia Ann "Tricia" Quirk Spitzmueller
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Tricia was born in Scottsbluff, NE on January 22nd, 1953. She also loved music. To her last day, she joked about "rubbing elbows" with Ken while she played guitar with him as a teenager, their first communication of love. She attended Derham Hall and Carleton College, earning a BA in Art History and Studio Art. She earned a degree in Pastoral Ministries from Loyola Chicago, worked as a Spiritual Director, and received international recognition for her textile arts. She was known for her undying compassion, boundless curiosity, and penchant for long, searching conversations."
cases.narrative: He reportedly shot her in the head and committed suicide.
